title: The Forgotten Oath
author: X. M. Almeida
blurb: Sebastian Pemberton, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
